action_items: OPTIONAL — When the font engine (drawtext) or FreeType-enabled ffmpeg lands, promote 'On-screen text & CTA overlays' and 'Thumbnail overlay text' from suggested_for_review to applied_by_engine in director_intelligence.py. The honest label 'planned — the bundled renderer lacks font support (drawtext)' becomes stale automatically at that point.
OPTIONAL — When MO-023 Licensed Sound Library™ lands, promote 'Music bed & timing' similarly and wire music_cues into the ffmpeg filter graph (currently music_cues are informational only).

OPTIONAL — Consider clamping xfade_dur to a slightly smaller value for very short scenes; today _video_graph already clamps to durations[i-1]/2 and durations[i]/2 which is correct, but a scene at the minimum 3.0s with a 0.5s xfade offset chain can push the final acc runtime into an odd number. Not a bug — just a small runtime-window optimization.
critical_code_review_comments: director_intelligence.py::build_plan — clean, single-responsibility, honest applied/suggested split enforced by data (not by comments). Arc role assignment via _role_for is deterministic; transitions cycle through 6 xfade names the bundled ffmpeg supports. Consider making _ROLE_DURATION / _ROLE_ENERGY constants exported so tests can import instead of duplicating the allowed-role set.

flagship_showcase.py::_video_graph — the xfade chaining formula (offset = max(0.1, acc - d), acc += durations[i] - d) is mathematically correct and the last output label is [vout], all intermediates are [vxN]. Verified with both 2- and 3-scene real renders. Robust; no changes required.

flagship_showcase.py::produce_flagship — direction plan is built AFTER approved scenes are resolved but BEFORE the per-scene ffmpeg segment build, so arc-based durations feed _seg_filter correctly via dplan['duration_seconds']. Good ordering.

routers/media_library.py::director_plan — DirectorInput allows any dict list without validation of scene_text length. Not exploitable but consider a Pydantic sub-model for scenes to reject empty payloads with a 422 instead of a valid-but-degenerate 1-scene plan.

FlagshipShowcase.js — the director-plan fetch is fire-and-forget (`.catch(() => setDirectorPlan(null))`) so a matcher failure silently hides the plan. Fine for MVP; consider surfacing a toast if the plan endpoint 500s so users know the render will still work but the plan preview is unavailable.
